message:
docs(update): a field check asked for an outcome that can no longer happen

UPD-FIELD-01 told whoever runs it to force a failure and confirm the
result is RollbackFailed when the client came back through the shell. That
was true when it was written. Since the optional images moved after the
commit there is no window in which an unownable process can block a
rollback, so the outcome cannot occur -- and a tester following the
instruction exactly would find nothing and have to decide what that meant.
The property is asserted by scenario 7 instead, which is where it belongs.

The same entry quoted log lines that no longer match: the phase split
prints "relaunch (optional) GNLinkClient.exe: ...". And it now says the
client appearing a few seconds after the host is normal, because the order
puts it there -- the failure to look for is the client coming back FIRST.

This is the second manual check in two days that could not be carried out
as written. Both were vacuous in the same way an assertion is vacuous:
they would be performed, and they would not test the thing.

The wiring plan needed the same treatment. W4a still described
RelaunchEffects::lastActions as something that exists but nobody reads --
it was deleted, on the grounds that output nobody reads is not a record
but an open item -- and still described relaunch as returning a single
bool. The audit table under "the facts first" was a snapshot from an old
commit and read as if it were current; its first two rows were closed when
GNLinkUpdater.exe gained a caller, and every line number in it has moved.
It now says so.
